correctness.rationale: For n=2..11 the source consists of binary words with length>=2 leading/trailing zero runs, singleton one runs, and at least two zeros between ones. Independently generated all source words, formed each distinct length-(n-1) deletion shadow and built the compatibility graph. Exhaustive recursive clique enumeration returned source cardinalities 1,1,1,2,3,4,6,9,13,19, exact optima 1,1,1,1,1,1,2,2,3,4 and labeled maximizing-code counts 1,1,1,2,3,4,1,6,3,3. At n=11 exactly three maxima exist; absence of clique size five is certified by complete 19-word compatibility-graph enumeration, not a heuristic. Their displayed codewords are compatible. Distinct shadow intersections are equivalent to LCS length >= n-1. No all-n statement was inferred.
